column7: A machine actor passed the router's secrets.write gate on bulk-rename, suspend-all and resume-all, then core refused actorID 0 with an untyped 'actor ID is required' that REST answered 400/500. Core now refuses it as a machine actor (refuseMachineActor, ErrPermissionDenied) and the three handlers answer 403. authzdiff known-10; the waiver open PR #4522 adds for these ops should not be needed once this lands
